title: HtmlU
responsibility: Renders the native u element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlU.attributes
inputs.description: Native u attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlU.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native u element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlU
outputs.description: The actual native u element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
